_notes: E13 - Department and multi-state overtime split. Two jobs on two wage-order rules (E13A / E13B, OT after 8, DT after 12), one crew day on -21: 6 h on Job A then 4 h on Job B.
Pooled, 10 h would read 8 regular + 2 overtime (220.00). With Group Overtime by Wage Order = Yes each bucket stays under 8: 6 + 4 regular, no overtime (200.00).
Rule, thresholds and the two jobs live in fixture.json (e13). Group Overtime by Wage Order is read on its screen, never written.
